day5_ending_forget_forced_1.text: *It's already too late. Only the cold mark where the needle was remains.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_3.text: *Nurse Riin closed her eyes. She said something, but the sound was distant, like underwater.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_4.text: *My consciousness sinks. Neither anger nor words will come.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_1.text: *Amidst the blackout, the emergency bell rang once. Someone roughly shoves my back.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_2.text: ...Don't stop. Your body remembers the way.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_3.text: *I ran up the stairs two at a time. Seolhwa seems to be leading. My feet are already headed for the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_4.text: Good. Keep going. Now, just push the door.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_5.text: *The door opened, and cold air rushed in. That's when I finally caught my breath.*

day5_ending_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The fingers gripping the syringe are white.*

day5_ending_true_3.text: ...okay. It's the door again this time.

day5_ending_true_4.text: *Ms. Eunsu steps aside with her eyes closed.*

day5_ending_true_5.text: *Yuna and I pass through the emergency exit onto the fire escape behind the old wing. The late-night air is cold. Streetlights line the road beyond the school fence.*

day5_ending_true_7.text:
*Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.*

Come with us. Could you get out if I held your hand?

day5_ending_true_11.text: *Seolhwa smiles. The emergency light passes through her face and lights the tiles behind her.*

day5_ending_true_12.text: Six times, I stopped here. Don't look back today.

day5_ending_true_13.text: My record ends here. You go through the door.

day5_ending_true_14.text: Lee Seolhwa. I’ll remember that name.

day5_ending_true_14a.text: ...So, in the end, I lost. To that child.

day5_ending_true_14b.text: *The teacher's hand went limp. The syringe fell to the floor and rolled away.*

day5_ending_true_15.text: *Seolhwa stopped. She looked back. Light glistened at the corners of her eyes, but the corners of her mouth were turned up.*

day5_ending_true_16.text: That’s the first time you’ve called me that.

day5_ending_true_17.text: *The outline of Seolhwa becomes blurred. Only the light remains on the stairs.*

day5_ending_true_18.text: *The smell of rainy stairs, a wet uniform sleeve, the cold hand that held my left -- all of it rushes in at once.*

day5_ending_true_19.text: *For an instant, scenes rush in with no order at all.*

day5_ending_true_20.text: *The rain at the library, the locked basement door, the hand I held while climbing over the fence. They come back one after another.*

day5_ending_true_21.text: *All twelve name tags in my memory are turned face down.*

day5_ending_true_21a.text: *Minsu’s profile picture is a blank gray image. I cannot recall my old classroom or why my parents moved. Only scenes of this school remain.*

day5_ending_true_22.text:
*As I drop to my knees, Yuna sits beside me and supports my back.*

Wait. Hold me. I can see the road, but I can't stand.

day5_ending_true_24.text:
Let's go. We'll keep talking outside. I don't want to stay here.

*Yuna looks across the dark sports field, toward the road outside the school fence, and speaks.*

day5_ending_true_26.text: *A news article. 'Unlicensed Research Facility Discovered at XX High School -- Allegations of Illegal Drug Administration and Human Clinical Trials'*

day5_ending_true_27.text: *'Multiple victims report memory disorders... Lead researcher B arrested' '3-year student C, who collected evidence while enrolled, played a decisive role in the expose'*

day5_ending_true_28.text: *I put down my phone. A new school, a new classroom. No familiar faces.*

day5_ending_true_29.text: *I looked at the name tag. My name. ...Not the 13th name, but the first one.*

day5_ending_true_30.text: *I copy the names onto paper. Seolhwa's name and every face that remains go on the same line.*

day5_ending_true_31.text: *I take the pencil in my left hand. A graphite mark forms beside my index finger.*

day5_postcredit_2.text: *A spacious office. Stacks of documents on a desk. Multiple monitors. A school blueprint on the screen.*

day5_postcredit_3.text: Yes. Confirmed. The site will be closed. Asset recovery is complete, personnel will be reassigned.

day5_postcredit_4.text: Close Case 13 at the site manager level. Do not leave the foundation's name behind.

day5_postcredit_5.text: ...Yes. The selection of the next pilot school is complete.

day5_postcredit_6.text: Has the staff reassignment proposal been submitted?

day5_postcredit_7.text: *The monitor screen changes. New school. New school uniform. New names. File title: 'Edina Foundation - Maladjusted Student Correction Program 2nd Base Implementation Plan'. The logo at the top of the document remains the same.*

day5_postcredit_8.text: *...A new transfer student's profile appears on screen. The student in the photo is smiling. With a face that knows nothing.*

day5_ending_escape_1.text: *I ran. With Yuna. Escaped the school.*

day5_ending_escape_2.text: *I looked back. No one is following.*

day5_ending_escape_3.text: *Even after I got outside the school gate, I could not stop running for a while.*

day5_ending_escape_4.text: Sunbae, we don’t have the documents. Just the photos on the camera.

day5_ending_escape_6.text: *I walked. The predawn road. Under a streetlight.*

day5_ending_escape_7.text: *...My head is quiet. Only the spot where Seolhwa had been standing stays blank.*

day5_ending_escape_8.text: *When I look back toward the school, only one third-floor window in the old building is dark and empty.*

day5_ending_escape_11.text:
*Yuna opens her mouth, then readjusts her grip on her bag strap without saying anything.*

Why? Was that a strange answer? Weren't you just asking?

day5_ending_escape_12.text: *...I was gripping the bag strap with my left hand. Unconsciously.*

day5_ending_escape_14.text: *I typed ○○ High School into the news search bar. No new articles appeared.*

day5_ending_escape_15.text: Sunbae. They say a new transfer student arrived at that school today.

day5_ending_resist_2.text: This probably isn’t your first signature. But you shouldn’t sign any more.

day5_ending_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_ending_resist_5.text: Every signature after that is in my handwriting, {name}.

day5_ending_resist_6.text: If you stay here, another student will end up in that seat.

day5_ending_resist_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu stops. Seolhwa appears—not behind her, but superimposed over my field of vision.*

day5_ending_resist_9.text: *The name leaves my mouth without thinking. Ms. Eunsu lowers the hand holding the syringe.*

day5_ending_resist_11.text: After that day, I watched six more times. You welcoming a new name tag.

day5_ending_resist_13.text: ...You need to leave too, Ms. Eunsu.

day5_ending_resist_14.text:
*Ms. Eunsu sets the syringe on the floor and stands there for a long time.*

Don't pick it up again. The door is open. Let's go together.

day5_ending_resist_15.text: ...Once I go outside, every document will have my name on it.

day5_ending_resist_18a.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_ending_resist_18b.text:
*Ms. Eunsu can’t finish the sentence. She closes her mouth.*

He trusted you. What did you do?

day5_ending_resist_18c.text: ...I erased it that night. The next morning, that student asked, 'Who are you, teacher?'

day5_ending_resist_18d.text: Even so, I signed. On the next line, and the one after that.

day5_ending_resist_19.text:
*Ms. Eunsu covers her mouth and cannot raise her head for a while.*

Look at me. I know. Going outside won't make the papers disappear.

day5_ending_resist_20.text: ...I erased you with my own hands. And yet?

day5_ending_resist_21.text: Once we get these records outside, you'll be held responsible. But that's better than writing the next line here.

day5_ending_resist_22.text:
*I pass through the emergency exit with Ms. Eunsu.*

*Seolhwa smiles from behind the door, her outline dissolving into the light on the stairs.*

day5_ending_resist_23.text: *Ms. Eunsu got out. But the stamp at the top of the documents remains.*

day5_ending_resist_24.text: *In the empty faculty room, a new homeroom teacher nameplate is set down. And at the empty desk -- a new transfer student.*

day5_ending_resist_subtitle.text: Defiance — Records Handed Over to the Outside.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_1.text:
*Night has fallen, but the classroom lights are still on. Ms. Eunsu sorts the attendance register as usual.*

Still looking at the register? Class is over. Can't we turn the lights off? Sitting here under all this light is a bit…

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_3.text: *I nodded. The words that had risen all the way up my throat sank back down.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_4.text: Starting tomorrow, just go back to normal. Same seat as in the attendance book.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_5.text: *The classroom door closed softly. Even knowing it wasn't locked, I didn't get up from my seat.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_6.text: *...The next afternoon. The same classroom, the same window seat. Ms. Eunsu's voice rings faintly, like a bell.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_7.text: *The same class every day. The same classroom every day. The same smile every day.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_8.text: *A car passes outside the window. I don't get up from my seat.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_9.text: *I looked out the window. The road beyond the fence. A car passes.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_11.text: *I could leave, but I don’t get up from the chair.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_3.text: I can stay here today, right?

day5_ending_cage_sea_4.text:
*I only nod. Sea rests her forehead on my shoulder and lets out a long breath.*

Yeah. I'll stay today. Just loosen your grip a little.

day5_ending_cage_sea_6.text: *...The student council room. Sea opened a lunchbox. She looks at me and smiles.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_7.text: *The thirteenth. Sea doesn't close the lunchbox. The seat across from her remains occupied.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_8.text: *Yuna's camera is not by the library window. Only the habit of touching the left wall every night remains.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_9.text: *Inside the desk drawer, one name tag still remains empty.*

day5_ending_cage_subtitle.text: Cage — The Seat I Chose to Stay In.

day5_ending_forget_4.text: All those blanks are my records, aren’t they?

day5_ending_forget_5.text: I can't. I don't think I can walk out carrying all those names.

day5_ending_forget_6.text: Please erase it. I keep seeing the names.

day5_ending_forget_7.text:
*Ms. Eunsu raises the syringe and brings it toward my arm.*

Can I close my eyes?

day5_ending_forget_9.text: *Numbness spreads through my arm from where the needle went in.*

day5_ending_forget_10.text: *Last seen — Seolhwa. The mouth moves. There is no sound.*

day5_ending_forget_11.text: *...I can read it. The movement of her lips.*

day5_ending_forget_14.text: *...It's bright. An alarm is ringing. I looked at my phone.*

day5_ending_forget_16.text: *The name is different. The face in the mirror looks familiar, but I can’t remember what to call it.*

day5_ending_forget_17.text: *My chin is wet. The thought of wiping it comes a beat late.*

day5_ending_forget_18.text: *I need to go to school. A new school.*

day5_ending_forget_19.text: *A teacher is standing at the school gate.*

day5_ending_forget_20.text: Welcome. You're {new_name}, right? The transfer student?

day5_ending_forget_21.text: I'll look after your school life from now on.

day5_ending_forget_22.text: *Ms. Eunsu smiles warmly. The corners of her mouth and eyes rise in perfect unison.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_1.text: *A girl is standing at the school gate. A bright smile. Class representative armband.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_2.text: Hi! You're the new transfer student, right? I'll show you around.

day5_ending_forget_sea_3.text: *...This person looks familiar. Where was it? ...I cannot remember.*

day5_ending_ghost_1.text: *My feet won't lift, as if they're stuck to the floor.*

day5_ending_ghost_3.text: *...Seolhwa appeared. Between me and Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_ending_ghost_7.text: Your feet stopped again. So this time, I stepped in front.

day5_ending_ghost_8.text: This time, I'll push you forward.

day5_ending_ghost_9.text:
*Seolhwa looks straight at me. I’ve never seen that look in any of the photos so far.*

Look outside, not at me. Are you looking at me like that because you mean to send only me out?

day5_ending_ghost_11.text: *My body moved. My toes turned toward the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_12.text: *I grabbed Yuna's hand and ran for the emergency exit. Ms. Eunsu shouted from behind but I didn't stop.*

day5_ending_ghost_13.text: *Outside the emergency exit, I look back. Seolhwa is smiling inside the door. I can see the wall through her.*

day5_ending_ghost_14.text: ...teacher. Next, there is no name tag.

day5_ending_ghost_15.text: *Seolhwa vanished. Soundlessly. At the same time, an alarm rang inside the building. Sirens, footsteps, and shouts tangled together.*

day5_ending_ghost_16.text: *Seolhwa's voice could no longer be heard. I escaped the school. Behind me, sirens wailed.*

day5_ending_ghost_17.text: *Even after transferring schools, I still avoid empty seats and touch the wall with my left hand.*

day5_ending_ghost_18.text: *Sometimes at night, when I look in the mirror, dark brown hair passes by one beat late.*

day5_ending_ghost_19.text: *When I pick up a pencil or turn left in a hallway, someone’s name comes to mind, then disappears.*

day5_ending_ghost_20.text: *Only the stroke bending left and the scratch on the second stair remain clear.*

day5_ending_ghost_21.text: *My left hand finds the rail first; I follow the left wall in corridors.*

day5_ending_ghost_22.text: *That school is still there. A new lock hangs on the emergency exit, and the key is in another hand.*

day5_ending_complicit_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu held out a piece of paper.*

day5_ending_complicit_2.text: You take charge of the next child. Then you can stay.

day5_ending_complicit_3.text: stay here I'll move the name to the top.

day5_ending_complicit_5.text: *I looked at the paper. 'Project Nevergrad -- Assistant Researcher Contract.'*

day5_ending_complicit_6.text: ...When the next child comes, can I smile at the front door too?

day5_ending_complicit_8.text: *I placed my hand on the contract.*

day5_ending_complicit_8a.text: *The edge of the paper catches against my palm.*

day5_ending_complicit_8b.text: *I can see the door handle. But my gaze stays on the signature line.*

day5_ending_complicit_sign.text: *The tip of the pen touches the signature line.*

day5_ending_complicit_12.text: *In the morning, a new student with a blank name tag walks toward the school gate.*

day5_ending_complicit_13.text: *Only the hair color is different. The hand habit of holding the bag strap is the same.*

day5_ending_complicit_15.text: *The new student nods without a word. The fingers around the bag strap curl three times.*

day5_ending_complicit_16.text: Don't worry. Everyone will take good care of you.

day5_ending_complicit_17.text: *Ms. Eunsu watches from behind. At the end of the hallway, Seolhwa stands without a word.*

day5_xover_server_1.text: *Connected to the institute's server. A file directory appears on the old monitor.*

day5_xover_preview_2.text: *Spring breeze. New uniform. First day of transfer.*

day5_xover_preview_3.text: *Cherry petals repeat from the same position. Only the wind direction changes.*

day5_xover_preview_4.text: *Bottom right of the screen, in small text: cycle_01*

*Emotional imprint model: {cupid_heroine}*

day5_observer_1.text: *The credits ended. The screen goes dark. Blackout.*

day5_observer_3.text: *Text appears one character at a time in the center of the screen.*

day5_observer_8.text:

Logs persisted after warning.

day5_observer_10.text: *And at the bottom, in very small text:*
